thread:
samir.patel: hey all — first day! running into a block: trying to open the onboarding Drive folder but Google says 'access denied' and Okta shows "device not trusted". super stuck, any pointers?

lina.it: welcome Samir :wave: — looks like device trust is enforced for Drive access. are you on a personal laptop or a corporate device?

samir.patel: personal for now. I did sign in to Okta and completed MFA (push) but still blocked.

helpdesk-bot: Automated check: device posture required for Google Drive. If using personal device, you must enroll via our Device Trust portal: https://okta.redwood.internal/device-enroll. 2FA + device cert are required.

lina.it: yep — Okta's device trust requires either:
- enroll your device (recommended) OR
- join the company VPN + use a company-managed browser profile (temporary)

samir.patel: enrollment page asks for a cert install. is that safe on my home laptop?

security: Hi Samir — short answer: we only install a lightweight device certificate that proves posture to Okta, not full MDM. It does not give us remote control or access to your files. Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/security/device-trust (see 'personal device' section).

lina.it: steps that usually work:
1) go to https://okta.redwood.internal/device-enroll
2) sign in with your Redwood account and complete Okta Verify if prompted
3) on mac: allow the profile install in System Preferences > Profiles; on Windows: approve the cert from the installer
4) reboot browser and try Drive again

samir.patel: ok trying step 1 now... getting a browser popup that says 'Install Redwood Device Certificate' and asks for admin password on mac. should I enter it?

anna.hr: if it's your personal machine and you're comfortable giving admin for the profile install, that's normal. If not, we can loan you a temporary company laptop for onboarding — ping me and I'll arrange pickup.

lina.it: yes that's expected on macs. if you don't want to enter admin creds on your personal device, request a loaner (anna.hr will set it up). otherwise enter your local admin password to allow the profile.

samir.patel: entered it, the enroll page now shows 'device enrolled — certificate active'. reopening Drive... still blocked.

helpdesk-bot: Confirming: Okta sees a new device cert for user samir.patel. Policy evaluation pending (may take up to 90s).

lina.it: try an incognito window or clear site data for accounts.google.com and then re-login. Okta can cache previous sessions that were non-compliant.

samir.patel: incognito worked! I can access the onboarding folder now. thanks everyone. one last q: do I still need 1Password? I set up Okta Verify only.

security: 1Password is our SSO credential store + secrets manager. You should provision your account and save your recovery codes there. Follow onboarding checklist: https://redwood.com/onboarding/checklist -> '1Password setup'.

samir.patel: great, will do that next. big thanks :raised_hands:

lina.it: welcome again — ping here if anything else blocks you. :white_check_mark:
